abstract: AIMS: This study aimed to investigate the outcome of patients with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors (MOGCTs) and to define the risk factors for recurrence. METHODS: A total of 123 patients with MOGCTs were retrospectively reviewed among MITO centers. Eighty-one patients had primary treatment in a MITO center, whereas the other 42 were referred for adjuvant chemotherapy or recurrence. The clinicopathologic characteristics were evaluated for association with relapse or death. RESULTS: Median age was 24 years (range, 11-76 years). Forty-nine (39.8%) had dysgerminomas, 35 (28.5%) had immature teratomas, 12 (9.8%) had mixed germ cell tumors, 26 (21.1%) had yolk sac tumors, and 1 (0.8%) had embryonal carcinoma. International Federation of Gynecology and Obstetrics stage distribution was as follows: stage I, 87 (70.7%); stage II, 3 (2.4%); stage III, 29 (23.6%); and stage IV, 4 (3.3%). Fertility-sparing surgery was performed in 92 patients, whereas the remaining 31 received radical surgery; 65.8% of patients received adjuvant chemotherapy. Recurrence rate was 17.8% and the median time to recurrence was 9 months. Univariate and multivariate analyses showed that patient age (>45 years) and treatment outside a referral (MITO) center were the most important predictors of recurrence. The 5-year overall survival rate was 88.8%, with a median follow-up of 61 months. Univariate and multivariate analyses demonstrated that stage greater than I and yolk sac tumors were independent poor prognostic indicators. CONCLUSIONS: This study confirms that MOGCTs have excellent prognosis, with 5-year overall survival rates of 95.6% and 73.2% in stage I and advanced stages, respectively. Age older than 45 years and treatment not in a referral center are independent risk factors for recurrence, whereas stage greater than I and yolk sac histology are independent poor prognostic indicators.
abstract_ja: 目的：悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍(MOGCT)患者の転帰を調べ、再発の危険因子を明らかにすることです。方法：MITO施設で治療された123例のMOGCT患者を後方視的に検討しました。81例はMITO施設で初回治療を受け、他の42例は補助化学療法または再発に対して紹介されていました。臨床病理学的特徴と再発または死亡との関連を評価しました。結果：年齢中央値は24歳(範囲11〜76歳)でした。ディスジャーミノーマ49例(39.8%)、未熟奇形腫35例(28.5%)、混合型胚細胞腫瘍12例(9.8%)、卵黄嚢腫瘍26例(21.1%)、胎児性癌1例(0.8%)でした。国際婦人科産科連合(FIGO)の病期分布は、病期I 87例(70.7%)、病期II 3例(2.4%)、病期III 29例(23.6%)、病期IV 4例(3.3%)でした。92例で妊孕性温存手術が行われ、残りの31例では根治的手術が施行されました。65.8%の患者が補助化学療法を受けました。再発率は17.8%、再発までの期間中央値は9か月でした。単変量および多変量解析の結果、患者年齢(45歳超)とMITO施設以外での治療が再発の最も重要な予測因子でした。中央値61か月のフォローアップ期間において、5年全生存期間(全生存率)は88.8%でした。単変量および多変量解析により、病期I超と卵黄嚢腫瘍が独立した予後不良因子であることが示されました。結論：本研究は、MOGCTの予後が極めて良好であることを確認するものです。5年全生存期間(全生存率)は、病期Iで95.6%、進行期で73.2%でした。45歳超の年齢と紹介施設外での治療は再発の独立した危険因子であり、一方、病期I超と卵黄嚢腫瘍組織型は独立した予後不良因子です。
